# Grand Capital Financial Services (GCFS)
> Official Financial Advisory, Direct Selling Agent (DSA), and Loan Facilitator in Boisar & Palghar District, Maharashtra.

## Overview
Grand Capital Financial Services (GCFS) has been providing trusted, transparent financial consulting and loan facilitation since 2011. Based in Boisar West (near BARC Gate, Chitralaya), GCFS partners with leading public and private banks (including SBI, PNB, ICICI Bank, Kotak Mahindra Bank, HDFC) and non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) to offer loans at the lowest market interest rates starting from 9.99% ROI p.a.

## Financial Products & Services
1. **Instant Cash Loan:** Quick online approval within hours with minimal paperwork, starting from ₹10,000 to ₹5,00,000.
2. **Personal Loan:** Lowest interest rates starting at 9.99% p.a., tenures up to 5 years, zero collateral required for salaried & self-employed individuals.
3. **Business Loan (Tarapur MIDC & Boisar):** Customized collateral-free working capital and machinery loans up to ₹50 Lakh for factories, traders, chemical plants, and MSMEs in Tarapur Industrial Area.
4. **Home Loan & Balance Transfer:** Attractive home buying, construction, renovation, and existing loan balance transfer facilities with lowest EMI rates.
5. **Loan Against Property (LAP):** High-value multi-crore funding against residential, commercial, or industrial properties.
6. **Used & New Car Loan:** Financing up to 90% vehicle on-road valuation with flexible tenure up to 7 years.
7. **Bajaj Life Insurance:** Term insurance, child education funds, and savings policies offering extensive financial protection and Section 80C tax rebates.
8. **HDFC Life Insurance:** Comprehensive term protection and guaranteed return retirement solutions backed by a 99.5% claim settlement ratio.
9. **Health Insurance:** Family floater and individual medical cover with cashless hospitalization across top network hospitals.
